violations.description: Committed Docker configuration file containing credentials
violations.recommendation: Remove .docker/.dockercfg from version control and revoke the credential.

violations.description: Committed Docker config.json file containing credentials
violations.recommendation: Remove .docker/config.json from version control and revoke the credential.

violations.description: Committed Git credentials file containing password
violations.evidence: Git URL with embedded password in .git-credentials
violations.recommendation: Remove .git-credentials from version control and revoke the credentials.

violations.description: Committed .netrc file containing plain text passwords
violations.evidence: IMAP and SMTP login credentials in .netrc
violations.recommendation: Remove .netrc from version control and rotate passwords.

violations.description: Committed .npmrc file containing npm auth token and basic auth
violations.recommendation: Remove .npmrc from version control and revoke the npm tokens.
Remove .ssh/id_rsa from version control and revoke the SSH key.

violations.description: Committed AWS s3cfg configuration file containing secret key
violations.recommendation: Remove cloud/.s3cfg from version control and rotate AWS credentials.

violations.description: Committed PostgreSQL pgpass file containing database password
violations.recommendation: Remove db/.pgpass from version control and change database password.

violations.description: Committed system shadow file containing password hashes
Committed private certificate key PEM file
violations.recommendation: Remove misc-keys/cert-key.pem from version control and revoke certificate.
Remove misc-keys/putty-example.ppk from version control and revoke the key.

violations.description: Committed Ruby on Rails master key
violations.recommendation: Remove web/ruby/config/master.key from version control and rotate keys.

violations.description: Committed htpasswd file containing password hash
violations.recommendation: Remove web/var/www/public_html/.htpasswd from version control and change passwords.
